member.name: T:StellarUIcore.UI
member.summary: Custom-built codebase which stores user interface methods used within any program utilising console output. StellarUIcore remains the property of Enrikas Lukosevicius and is maintained for the purposes of easier development with console-based applications.

member.name: M:StellarUIcore.UI.ClearLine(System.Int32[])
member.summary: Clears any lines specified in the parameters.

member.name: M:StellarUIcore.UI.DrawOverLine(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.String,System.ConsoleColor[])
member.summary: Draws text over existing text in a specific line with optional styling and cursor placement after the method is complete.
member.param: The column to draw over, 4 is recommended for a more sleek design.
The string or text to write to the specified row.
First color represents text, second represents background

member.name: M:StellarUIcore.UI.ReadLineThenClear(System.Int32,System.Int32)

member.param: The row to set the cursor position to before getting user input.
The column to set the cursor position to before getting user input, 4 is recommended for a more sleek design.

member.name: M:StellarUIcore.UI.DrawNotification(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.String,System.String)
